label: Diagnostic centres
eyebrow: For diagnostic centres · sample to report
h1Parts: Reports the patient doesn’t call you about
lead: Diagnostic centres live and die by turnaround time and report-pickup. Lucoze is built around the sample lifecycle — collection, processing, signing, dispatch — with home-collection routing built in.
why: Phlebotomist routes auto-generated by city zone. Collection complete → sample reaches the lab → patient gets WhatsApp — no phone calls.
Barcode at collection, audit trail through processing and signing. Inspection bundle on demand.
Tests that go to a reference lab tracked alongside in-house — same patient view, same TAT.
Hospital + clinic referrals invoiced separately. Revenue split visible per partner per month.
